symptom: `mxcli check` rejects a **valid** microflow: **MDL048** on `retrieve … where [id = '[%CurrentUser%]']` (the standard signed-in-user idiom) — but `mx check` → 0 errors
cause: MDL048 targets constraining `id` against a STORED value (String/Long var or plain literal), which Mendix XPath can't do; it also matched the `'[%CurrentUser%]'` **server token**, which Mendix DOES resolve to a GUID
insight: Skip an operand of the form `'[%…%]'` (a resolved token) before flagging. Case still fires for real stored-id values. Test `TestValidateMicroflow_XPathIdConstraint` (CurrentUser case); repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/52-53-microflow-check-false-positives.mdl`. FINDINGS #53
